Maya (CSM): FYI flagged Solstice Labs 3: huge drop in API calls after yesterday's quota enforcement. traffic down ~74% week-over-week. tagging for renewal triage (renewal ~4w).

analytics-bot: Automated summary  Solstice Labs: requests: 18,400 -> 4,800 (-73.9%), errors: 429.rate_limit_exceeded (5,120), top endpoints: /v1/generate, recent spike at 09:14 UTC. health: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/solstice/health
```
-- quick query
SELECT count(*) as reqs, sum(case when status=429 then 1 else 0 end) as rate_limited
FROM api_events
WHERE account='solstice' AND event_time >= now() - interval '7 days';
```

Omar (Eng): We rolled out a stricter per-org QPS policy on the new billing cycle; looks like Solstice hit the new thresholds. 429s are legit. We can temporarily bump their limit from 10 QPS -> 60 QPS for 72h while CS/AE engage. Need approval for transient capacity.

Priya (Customer Ops): Procurement contact changed last week (new buyer: Carver). They declined the automatic invoice increase and asked us to revert to legacy plan while they re-evaluate. That likely explains the sudden drop.

Lena (AE): Renewal in ~4w. Also heard AtlasAI ran a 2-week pilot and sent a perf deck claiming 30% lower token latency. Customer is asking for a cost/latency comparison. We should be proactive.

Maya (CSM): Risk = high (usage drop + procurement churn + competitor pilot). Proposed short-term play: offer a 72h quota lift + a 14-day Dedicated trial (no SLA changes in comms until legal signs off). Will ask Product for a perf brief we can share.

Ravi (Product): I can assemble side-by-side telemetry (p95 latency, mean token cost, tail error rate). Need time window and sample prompts from Solstice. @Lena can you share the AtlasAI claim deck?

Lena (AE): Sharing deck now in DM. Also will not promise Dedicated without Legal/Finance.

Maya (CSM): Action items:
- Maya: outbound to Carver with troubleshooting + offer quota bump while we discuss procurement
- Omar: open emergency ticket to apply 72h quota override and add rate-limit rule in 'soft' mode
- Priya: intro to Carver + note about contract cadence
- Ravi: perf brief by EOD
- Lena: coordinate procurement thread, avoid contract terms (Legal required)

Omar (Eng): Quick ops command to bump quota (internal only):
```bash
# temp quota bump for account 'solstice'
redwoodctl org quota set --org solstice --qps 60 --duration 72h
```
I'll file the ticket and mark P1.

finance-bot: NOTE: Temporary quota increases under 7 days will be billed at the metered rate and reconciled on next invoice. If we convert to Dedicated trial, finance review required.

Priya (Customer Ops): I'll schedule a quick intro call with Carver this afternoon. Maya, prefer I join the call?

Maya (CSM): Yes please. Hoping to get them back above 50% baseline so renewal conversation has a better footing.

analytics-bot: I'll monitor and post an alert if request volume doesn't recover to >50% of baseline within 12h. :eyes:
